name: Parse variant notation
description: Parse a synthetic HGVS or coordinate-like variant string into a typed variant object while preserving accession versions.
observation: A typed synthetic variant object was created.

name: Lift GRCh37 coordinates to GRCh38
description: Convert a parsed synthetic variant from GRCh37 to GRCh38 and require reference allele verification afterward.
observation: Coordinates were lifted to GRCh38; alleles must be reverified.

name: Verify GRCh38 reference allele
description: Check the reference and alternate allele against the pinned GRCh38 reference snapshot.
observation: The synthetic reference and alternate allele were verified.

name: Normalize variant
description: Normalize an allele-verified GRCh38 variant into a canonical representation without dropping its reference provenance.
observation: The variant was normalized with the synthetic SPDI-like rule.

name: Annotate normalized variant
description: Retrieve synthetic consequence and gene annotations for a normalized GRCh38 variant.
observation: Synthetic gene and consequence annotations were attached.

name: Match HPO phenotype
description: Rank synthetic candidate genes from the provided HPO phenotype terms.

name: Retrieve gene-disease evidence
description: Retrieve snapshot-pinned synthetic disease evidence after a gene has been identified by variant annotation.

name: Integrate evidence report
description: Combine variant annotation, phenotype ranking, and gene-disease evidence into a final research-only report.
observation: The synthetic evidence report is ready.
